name: Tibial Spine / Tibial Eminence Fracture
definition: Avulsion fracture of the tibial attachment of the ACL, most common in skeletally immature patients and functionally analogous to an ACL injury.

core: ACL stability after acute pain allows

investigations.principle: Radiographs are first-line; MRI assesses displacement, meniscal entrapment and associated injuries.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Displaced fractures commonly require arthroscopic reduction/fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Avulsion fracture of the tibial attachment of the ACL, most common in skeletally immature patients and functionally analogous to an ACL injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
